name: Heartland
title: Heartland
summary: The drop point of the Heartland portals at 22.6N 37.2E: a small farmstead with a farmer, a few cows and an empty chest. In the kit: two stone cottages (a two-storey house with chimney and a two-storey hut) with brass lanterns at the doors around a grassy yard in a hollow (z 62), cows and an auroch cow, small trees around.

shots.standingOrder: Pull back and up south from the Heartland farmyard, its two stone cottages, brass lanterns and grazing cows shrinking into the rolling green hills; keep 6 m above every tree.
shots.notes: Small-place closer: dronie from 16 m to 62 m south of the Heartland farmyard (5 -> 30 m up): the two stone cottages with their brass lanterns, the cows in the yard and the rolling grassland around shrink into the hills; noon sun behind the lens.
